Audited Annual Ba lance Sheet along with IT returns of the three financial years to be submitted by the Bid ders. 4) (i) The bidder, if OEM, shall submit relevant documentary evidence in support of their experience in the field of “Manufacturing & Supply of GPS BASED DIGITAL INDU STRIAL CLOCK. Orga nizations/Scheduled Banks. a. Three completed orders each consisting of not less than or equal to 1 GPS BASED DIGITAL INDUSTRIAL CLOCK (30% of the tendered quantity). b. Two completed orders each consisting of not less than or equal to 2 GPS BASED DIGITAL INDUSTRIAL CLOCK (50% of the tendered quantity). c. One completed order of not less than or equal to 4 GPS BASED DIGITAL I NDUSTRIAL CLOCK (100% of the tendered quantity). 6) The tenderer is required to submit self attested photocopies of documents in support of their eligibility and experience along with the techno- commercial bid. In addition, bi dder shall submit an affidavit in enclosed format (Annexure-A) declaring that the docu ments submitted by them are genuine. 7) BSL reserves the right to call for original documents for verification at any time during tendering, evaluation and/or the execution of the contract. In case of any documents/in formation submitted by bidder(s) found to be false or containing any misrepresentation of having any fraudulent declaration in it, then in such eventuality, legal action (includi ng cancellation of contract, banning of business dealing, damages, criminal proceeding s etc.) as deemed fit may be initiated by BSL against the bidder. 8) A relaxation of 15% in Financial Turnover criteria is given to MSEs who are eligible for preference and Startups that are recognized by Department for Industry & Internal Tra de (DPIIT). However both MSE and Startups shall have to meet eligibility conditions for quality & technical specifications/requirement. 1. Unloading Responsibility : BSL 2.
